steps: Triggers tab → Updates field → drop on canvas
Custom field → last_trigger → value equals trigger_name → Save
Plus under trigger → Rules & actions → Send email → drop
Email name = automation_name; Subject = subject; Preheader = preheader; From Her Wellness Harmony / support@…
Design email → Start from scratch → Simple editor
